## User Stories

- **Acceptance Criteria:**

  - [ ] Example demonstrates minimum required props
  - [ ] Code includes helpful comments explaining key parts
  - [ ] Code is formatted and syntactically correct
  - [ ] Example can be copied and pasted directly

### Add Example Component File
- **Story:** As a developer, I want a standalone example component file so that I can see ReportHeader in a working context
- **Priority:** P2
- **Story Points:** 3
- **Acceptance Criteria:**
  - [ ] Create BasicUsageExample.tsx file
  - [ ] Implement working example component
  - [ ] Include proper TypeScript types
  - [ ] Add comments explaining the implementation
  - [ ] Ensure component can be imported and reused

### Test Basic Usage Example
- **Story:** As a developer, I want the basic usage example to be tested so that I can trust it works correctly

- **Story Points:** 2
- **Acceptance Criteria:**
  - [ ] Write unit tests for BasicUsageExample component

  - [ ] Test with minimum required props
  - [ ] Ensure example matches documentation
  - [ ] Add snapshot test
